subject.title: fix: suppress exec-like tool error warnings regardless of includeDetails

question: Should exec-like tool failures with details be suppressed for all chat-facing runs, or should cron, heartbeat, full-verbose, and mutating exec/bash failures keep visible warnings?
rationale: Existing tests intentionally surface several exec detail cases, while the linked issue and PR request suppressing exec-like warnings regardless of includeDetails; choosing the permanent user-visible policy needs maintainer intent before rewriting code and tests.

options.title: Clarify and repair policy
options.body: Pick the exec-warning visibility contract first, then update the policy ordering and regression tests to match it.

options.title: Keep current detail exceptions
options.body: Reject the suppress-all request and narrow the linked issue to cases that are warning noise rather than cron, heartbeat, or verbose diagnostics.

recommendation.title: Clarify and repair policy
recommendation.body: Pick the exec-warning visibility contract first, then update the policy ordering and regression tests to match it.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent work on the mutation-helper and adjacent payload policy surfaces makes this the strongest available routing signal for the policy decision.
